caption:
A missed call becomes a lost lead the moment nobody follows up.

Most service businesses miss that first-hour window with a new lead. A missed call rarely gets a voicemail. The caller just dials the next name on the list.

BlackMat's missed-call text-back fires the moment a call drops, so the lead gets a reply while you're still on the job. Review requests and win-back texts run the same way, automatically, once you turn them on.
